name: DEEP FREEZER (-20°C)
desc: Premium Vertical Laboratory Deep Freezer designed for long-term storage of critical biological products, enzymes, and vaccines. Features a 240-liter high-grade Stainless Steel internal cabinet with 3 insulated inner compartments and a fully programmable microprocessor controller.
features: Operating Temperature Range from -10°C down to -25°C
3 Independent inner storage compartments fitted with insulated doors
High-efficiency Direct Cooling system layout with CFC-free refrigerants
Fully programmable microprocessor control with membrane keypad
Audible and visible alarm system for unwanted temp rise and power failure

specifications.Equipment Function: Long-term secure storage of biological products, ATCC cultures, enzymes, and vaccines
specifications.External Enclosure Build: Heavy-Duty Galvanized Steel Body with tough, scratch-resistant powder coated finish
specifications.Inner Compartments Design: 3 Independent inner storage compartments fitted with insulated doors
specifications.Shelving & Racks System: 4 Heavy-Duty Corrosion-Resistant Racks included for sample separation
specifications.Mobility & Positioning: Heavy-duty lockable castors with a standard 100 mm ground clearance
specifications.Outer Door Security: Lockable outer door and lid assembly with robust key system
specifications.Refrigeration System Eco-Type: Energy-efficient system using CFC-free & HCFC-free non-flammable refrigerants
specifications.Pull Down Performance: High-capacity thermal response pulling down to max low in 5.2 Hours
specifications.Controller Architecture: Fully programmable microprocessor control with membrane keypad and eye-level panel
specifications.Integrated Safety Alarms: Audible and visible alarm system for unwanted temp rise, power failure, and low battery
specifications.Acoustic Noise Level: Silent laboratory operations (Maximum Noise Level ≤ 60 dB)
specifications.Energy Consumption Rate: High efficiency eco-design rating at 4 KWh/day
specifications.Voltage Stabilization Support: Compatible with external stabilizers running anywhere between 190V to 270V
specifications.Quality & Safety Standards: CE Certified & IEC 61010-1 / IEC 61010-2-40 Safety Compliant
specifications.Warranty Cover Protection: 1 Year Comprehensive Manufacturer Warranty from the date of installation
